LESSON: READING 10.2.1 STUDY SKILLS: NOTE MAKING

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 8
Subject: ENGLISH FOR LEARNERS WITH PHYSICAL IMPAIRMENT
Strand: Strand 10
Topic 10.2: Reading 10.2.1 Study Skills: Note Making
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading 10.2.1 Study Skills: Note Making, part of Strand 10 in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 8 ENGLISH FOR LEARNERS WITH PHYSICAL IMPAIRMENT.

Key inquiry question: How do we determine what to include in our notes during note making? 2. What is the importance of note making?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. identify key points in a text,

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading 10.2.1 Study Skills: Note Making together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Digital literacy is enhanced as the learner interacts with technology as they use electronic devices to get information.

• Communication and collaboration is enhanced as the learner collaborates with peers to discuss words used in writing.

Values:
Respect is promoted as the learner demonstrates patience while working with peers to search online and offline on how to make

notes.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs)

Mentorship is promoted as reading a text on Art helps learners identify some careers related to art.

Link to other subjects:

Note making skills are invaluable in all subjects as it is part of the array of study skills necessary across the board.
